assertions.description: URL.createObjectURL is how a page turns its own bytes into a loadable URL; the whole feature is about what happens when one of those is drawn to a canvas.
getImageData is the readback operation the tainting rule guards.

Drawing an SVG that contains a foreignObject from a blob: URL must leave the canvas readable. Before Chrome 156 getImageData() threw SecurityError here, while the identical markup delivered as a data: URI did not.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const svg='';const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([svg],{type:'image/svg+xml'}));try{const img=new Image();await new Promise((res,rej)=>{img.onload=res;img.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('load failed'));img.src=url;});const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=8;c.height=8;const x=c.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(img,0,0);x.getImageData(0,0,1,1);return true;}catch(e){return false;}finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}})()

assertions.description: The data: URI case has always been clean in every engine. It is the control: if this fails, the harness is broken rather than the browser.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const svg='';try{const img=new Image();await new Promise((res,rej)=>{img.onload=res;img.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('load failed'));img.src='data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(svg);});const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=8;c.height=8;const x=c.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(img,0,0);x.getImageData(0,0,1,1);return true;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: A blob: SVG with no foreignObject must be clean regardless of this change, which separates the URL scheme from the foreign-content rule.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const svg='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="8" height="8"><rect width="8" height="8" fill="#000"/></svg>';const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([svg],{type:'image/svg+xml'}));try{const img=new Image();await new Promise((res,rej)=>{img.onload=res;img.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('load failed'));img.src=url;});const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=8;c.height=8;const x=c.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(img,0,0);x.getImageData(0,0,1,1);return true;}catch(e){return false;}finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}})()

assertions.description: Readback and export share the origin-clean check, so a canvas drawn from a blob: foreignObject must also export. This is the operation authors actually hit, since a screenshot library ends at toDataURL or toBlob.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const svg='';const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([svg],{type:'image/svg+xml'}));try{const img=new Image();await new Promise((res,rej)=>{img.onload=res;img.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('load failed'));img.src=url;});const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=8;c.height=8;c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0);return c.toDataURL('image/png').startsWith('data:image/png');}catch(e){return false;}finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}})()
